settings.settings_source: none of its own: items, F, M, D, the SAEs (E234 scored, seed 0), gain_batch 8 and K* (all of D, polished) are E245's and E251's, read from their predictions.json (sha256 above, checked at start) and saved results; the KL-matched random's scale is E251's saved x 6.386264503002167 (results/items/random_kl_241002.json); fp32, no TF32, as E245

readings.E_b: over K*'s changed members u (every latent and the remainder of a changed site): sum of (num_u - den_u)^2 / den_u (0 where M writes zero or num_u / den_u <= 0) over sum of dd_u = |write_F_u - write_M_u|^2, every position of D in F's own run (commute.stand_in.explained_share, P1.49's expression, the same as E257 at VPD). 1 when K* has no changed member. Blind to: how much a part's write matters for behaviour (weighted by write change, not by effect on the logits); to whether K* is right (takes the saved K*); and, at SAE, to how the change splits between latents and the site's remainder, so remainder_dd_share_in_changed_K is reported beside it. Positive control: the reuse built edits (x2, x10, rebuilt) at VPD read 0.76, 0.76, 0.63
readings.untouched_share: share of K* (by count) at unchanged sites; reported beside E_b, as the user asked
readings.remainder_dd_share_in_changed_K: share of the changed K* members' write change dd carried by the site remainders in K*
readings.gain_rel_dev_saved: max relative |num/den - E245's saved gain|: the same sums as E245's gains; 0 on the same card and reduction order, reported only

rules.R0: Each job's stage 0 stops it, nothing read, on any miss: on the do-nothing no changed site, every dd exactly 0.0 and E_b exactly 1.0. Per item, the job stops if the variable count or the changed set differs from the saved one (K* would index other variables). Edge cases: the do-nothing has no changed member, so the convention gives E_b exactly 1 with no division
rules.P1: the built order at SAE. gap = min E_b over {x2, x10, rebuilt} - max E_b over {new_few, new_thin, random_size_241001, random_kl_241002, the 15 random_e58 updates}. gap >= 0.2 reads rival a (order holds at SAE); gap < 0.2 reads rival b (order lost). An item whose K* has no changed member (n_changed_in_K = 0) has no E_b of its own; it is listed and left out of both sets; if every item of a set is left out, P1 reads 'no call'. moved is reported but in neither set (no E_b at VPD to compare). Ties: a gap of exactly 0.2 reads rival a. Do-nothing: in neither set; it reads 1 by convention and could not pass or fail the rule
rules.pairs, keys: descriptive, no rule: E_b at SAE beside E_b at VPD (E257) per item, and the nine pairs' reuse-minus-new gap in E_b at both featurizations
